\n કિમી/કલાક છે.

\n\n

પ્રવાહની દિશામાં ગતિ = x + 6

\n\n

પ્રવાહની વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં ગતિ = x - 6

\n\n

પ્રવાહની દિશામાં લીધેલ સમય = 56 / (x + 6)

\n\n

પ્રવાહની વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં લીધેલ સમય = 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

કુલ સમય = પ્રવાહની દિશામાં સમય + પ્રવાહની વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં સમય

\n\n

⇒ 7 = 56 / (x + 6) + 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

⇒ (x + 6)(x - 6) વડે ગુણાકાર કરો

\n\n

⇒ 7 x (x + 6)(x - 6) = 56 x (x - 6) + 39 x (x + 6)

\n\n

⇒ 7(x2 - 36) = 56x - 336 + 39x + 234

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 252 = 95x - 102

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 95x - 150 = 0

\n\n

ચતુર્ભુજ સૂત્રનો ઉપયોગ કરીને:

\n\n

⇒ x = [-(-95) ± √((-95)2 - 4 x 7 x (-150))] / (2 x 7)

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √(9025 + 4200)] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √13225] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± 115] / 14

\n\n

ધનાત્મક મૂલ્ય લેતા:

\n\n

⇒ x = (95 + 115) / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 210 / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 15 કિમી/કલાક

\n\n

સ્થિર પાણીમાં બોટની ગતિ 15 કિમી/કલાક છે.

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ = 6 ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಮಿಸಿದ ದೂರ = 56 ಕಿ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಮಿಸಿದ ದೂರ = 39 ಕಿ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ಒಟ್ಟು ಸಮಯ = 7 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು

\n\n

ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

\n\n

ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ = (ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ + ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ) / 2

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ = ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ + ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ = ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ - ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ

\n\n

ಸಮಯ = ದೂರ / ಜವ

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವವನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ = 6 ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಮಿಸಿದ ದೂರ = 56 ಕಿ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಮಿಸಿದ ದೂರ = 39 ಕಿ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ಒಟ್ಟು ಸಮಯ = 7 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು

\n\n

ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

\n\n

ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ = (ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ + ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ) / 2

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ = ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ + ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ

\n\n

ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಜವ = ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವ - ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಜವ

\n\n

ಸಮಯ = ದೂರ / ಜವ

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

ಸ್ಥಿರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಣಿಯ ಜವವನ್ನು கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

\n\n

நீரோடையின் வேகம் = 6 கிமீ/மணி

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்தின் தூரம் = 56 கிமீ

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிரான தூரம் = 39 கிமீ

\n\n

மொத்த நேரம் = 7 மணிநேரம்

\n\n

பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட சூத்திரம்:

\n\n

நிலையான நீரில் படகின் வேகம் = (நீரோட்டத்தின் வேகம் + நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிரான வேகம்) / 2

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்தின் வேகம் = நிலையான நீரில் படகின் வேகம் + நீரோடையின் வேகம்

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிரான வேகம் = நிலையான நீரில் படகின் வேகம் - நீரோடையின் வேகம்

\n\n

நேரம் = தூரம் / வேகம்

\n\n

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

நிலையான நீரில் படகின் வேகம் x\" id=\"MathJax-Element-2-Frame\" role=\"presentation\" style=\"position: relative;\" tabindex=\"0\">xx\" id=\"MathJax-Element-5-Frame\" role=\"presentation\" style=\"position: relative;\" tabindex=\"0\">xx கிமீ/மணி ஆக இருக்கட்டும்.

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்தின் வேகம் = x + 6

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிரான வேகம் = x - 6

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்தில் எடுத்த நேரம் = 56 / (x + 6)

\n\n

நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிராக எடுத்த நேரம் = 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

மொத்த நேரம் = நீரோட்டத்தில் எடுத்த நேரம் + நீரோட்டத்திற்கு எதிராக எடுத்த நேரம்

\n\n

⇒ 7 = 56 / (x + 6) + 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

⇒ (x + 6)(x - 6) ஆல் பெருக்கவும்

\n\n

⇒ 7 x (x + 6)(x - 6) = 56 x (x - 6) + 39 x (x + 6)

\n\n

⇒ 7(x2 - 36) = 56x - 336 + 39x + 234

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 252 = 95x - 102

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 95x - 150 = 0

\n\n

இருபடி சூத்திரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி:

\n\n

⇒ x = [-(-95) ± √((-95)2 - 4 x 7 x (-150))] / (2 x 7)

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √(9025 + 4200)] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √13225] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± 115] / 14

\n\n

நேர்மறை மதிப்பை எடுத்துக்கொண்டால்:

\n\n

⇒ x = (95 + 115) / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 210 / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 15 கிமீ/மணி

\n\n

நிலையான நீரில் படகின் வேகம் 15 கிமீ/மணி.

\n\n16a:Tca9,\n

ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = 6 km/h

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਦੂਰੀ = 56 km 

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਦੂਰੀ = 39 km 

\n\n

ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = 7 ਘੰਟੇ

\n\n

ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ :

\n\n

ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ = (ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਲ + ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਚਾਲ ) / 2

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਲ = ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ + ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਚਾਲ = ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ - ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਸਮਾਂ = ਦੂਰੀ / ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਗਣਨਾ:ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = 6 km/h

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਦੂਰੀ = 56 km 

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਦੂਰੀ = 39 km 

\n\n

ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = 7 ਘੰਟੇ

\n\n

ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ :

\n\n

ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ = (ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਲ + ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਚਾਲ ) / 2

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਲ = ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ + ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਚਾਲ = ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ - ਨਦੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਸਮਾਂ = ਦੂਰੀ / ਚਾਲ 

\n\n

ਗਣਨਾ:

\n\n

ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ x km/h ਹੈ।

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਲ = x + 6

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਚਾਲ = x - 6

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = 56 / (x + 6)

\n\n

ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਲੱਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਾਂ + ਨਦੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ ਸਮਾਂ

\n\n

⇒ 7 = 56 / (x + 6) + 39 / (x - 6)

\n\n

⇒ (x + 6)(x - 6) ਨਾਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਰੋ

\n\n

⇒ 7 x (x + 6)(x - 6) = 56 x (x - 6) + 39 x (x + 6)

\n\n

⇒ 7(x2 - 36) = 56x - 336 + 39x + 234

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 252 = 95x - 102

\n\n

⇒ 7x2 - 95x - 150 = 0

\n\n

ਦੋ ਘਾਤੀ ਸੂਤਰ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਹੋਏ:

\n\n

⇒ x = [-(-95) ± √((-95)2 - 4 x 7 x (-150))] / (2 x 7)

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √(9025 + 4200)] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± √13225] / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = [95 ± 115] / 14

\n\n

ਧਨਾਤ੍ਮਕ ਮੁੱਲ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ:

\n\n

⇒ x = (95 + 115) / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 210 / 14

\n\n

⇒ x = 15 ਕਿਮੀ/ਘੰਟਾ

\n\n

ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ 15 km/h ਹੈ।

"b=4"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "b=12"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

In a continued proportion, consecutive terms are multiplied by a constant ratio.

\n

Common ratio = Second term ÷ First term = 6 ÷ 3 = 2

\n

Fourth term b = Third term × common ratio

\n

⇒ b = 12 × 2 = 24

\n

∴ The correct answer is 24.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Four numbers 3, 6, 12, and b are in continued proportion.

\n

Concept Used:

\n

For terms a, b, c, d in continued proportion, the ratio between consecutive terms is equal: a / b = b / c = c / d

\n\n\n\n

Calculation:

\n

⇒ 3 / 6 = 6 / 12 = 12 / b

\n

⇒ 1 / 2 = 1 / 2 = 12 / b

\n

Equating the last terms and cross-multiplying:

\n

⇒ 1 / 2 = 12 / b

\n

⇒ b = 12 × 2

\n

⇒ b = 24

\n

∴ The correct answer is 24.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Continued Proportion

\n

When quantities are in continued proportion, the ratio between consecutive terms remains exactly the same. i.e., a / b = b / c = c / d.

\n

Mean Proportional

\n

For two numbers a and b, their mean proportional x satisfies a / x = x / b, which directly gives x = √(a × b).

\n

Third Proportional

\n

If a and b are two numbers, the third proportional c satisfies a / b = b / c, which can be solved as c = b2 ÷ a.

""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Direct formula for Principal (P) when 2-year Simple Interest (SI) and Compound Interest (CI) are given:

\n

P = (SI ÷ 2)2 ÷ (CI − SI)

\n

Substitute the given values (SI = 40, CI = 56):

\n

P = (40 ÷ 2)2 ÷ (56 − 40)

\n

P = (20)2 ÷ 16 = 400 ÷ 16 = 25

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹25.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Time (T) = 2 years, SI = ₹40, CI = ₹56

\n

Formula Used:

\n

SI for 1 year = Total SI ÷ 2

\n

CI for 2 years = Total SI + Interest on 1st year's SI

\n\n\n\n

Calculation:

\n

⇒ SI for 1st year = 40 ÷ 2 = ₹20

\n

⇒ Difference (CI − SI) = 56 − 40 = ₹16

\n

⇒ This difference is simply the interest earned on the 1st year's SI.

\n

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = (16 ÷ 20) × 100 = 80%

\n

⇒ We know that, SI for 1 year = (P × R × 1) ÷ 100

\n

⇒ 20 = (P × 80) ÷ 100

\n

⇒ P = (20 × 100) ÷ 80

\n

⇒ P = 2000 ÷ 80 = ₹25

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹25.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

\n

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years can be directly found using: D = P × (R ÷ 100)2

\n

Difference Between CI and SI for 3 Years

\n

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 3 years is given by: D = P × (R ÷ 100)2 × (3 + R ÷ 100)

\n

Ratio of CI and SI for 2 Years

\n

For the same principal and rate of interest over 2 years, the ratio of CI to SI is expressed as: CI ÷ SI = 1 + (R ÷ 200)

दिया गया है:

\n\n

2 वर्षों में साधारण ब्याज (SI) = ₹40

\n\n

2 वर्षों में चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (CI) = ₹56

\n\n

ब्याज दर, साधारण ब्याज और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दोनों के लिए समान है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

1. साधारण ब्याज (SI) = (P x R x T) / 100

\n\n

2. चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (CI) = P x ((1 + R / 100)T - 1)

\n\n

3. चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर, दूसरे वर्ष में अर्जित ब्याज है:

\n\n

CI - SI = (P x R2) / 10000

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

2 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर है:

\n\n

CI - SI = ₹56 - ₹40 = ₹16

\n\n

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच अंतर के लिए सूत्र का उपयोग करें:

\n\n

16 = (P x R2) / 10000

\n\n

⇒ P x R² = 16 x 10000 = 160000

\n\n

अब, 2 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज के सूत्र का उपयोग करें:

\n\n

SI = (P x R x 2) / 100

\n\n

SI = ₹40 प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

\n\n

40 = (P x R x 2) / 100

\n\n

⇒ P x R = 2000

\n\n

अब, हमारे पास दो समीकरणों की प्रणाली है:

\n\n

1. P x R² = 160000

\n\n

2. P x R = 2000

\n\n

समीकरण (2) से, P = 2000 / R. इसे समीकरण (1) में प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

\n\n

(2000 / R) x R² = 160000

\n\n

⇒ 2000 x R = 160000

\n\n

⇒ R = 160000 / 2000 = 80

\n\n

समीकरण (2) में R = 80 प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

\n\n

P x 80 = 2000

\n\n

⇒ P = 2000 / 80 = 25

\n\n

मूलधन ₹25 है।

Shortcut Trick\n

Males = 192,000 and Total Population = 384,000, so Females = 192,000, giving a Male to Female ratio of 1 : 1.

\n

For groups with equal ratio, the overall percentage is the simple average of their individual percentages.

\n

⇒ (Male Literacy % + Female Literacy %) ÷ 2 = Overall Literacy %

\n

⇒ (53% + Female Literacy %) ÷ 2 = 69%

\n

⇒ Female Literacy % = 138% − 53% = 85%

\n

∴ The correct answer is 85%.

⇒ साक्षर महिलाएँ = 264960 - 101760

\n\n

⇒ साक्षर महिलाएँ = 163200

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ साक्षर महिलाओं का प्रतिशत = (163200 / 192000) x 100

\n\n

⇒ साक्षर महिलाओं का प्रतिशत = 85%

\n\n

साक्षर महिलाओं का प्रतिशत 85% है।

"value": "724"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "450"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "600"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

For equal amounts at Compound Interest, the ratio of shares P1 / P2 = (1 + R/100)t2 − t1.

\n

Pravin's Share / Rishi's Share = (1 + 4/100)15 − 14 = 1.04 = 26/25.

\n

Ratio of Pravin's share to Rishi's share = 26 : 25.

\n

Rishi's Share = (25 / 51) × 1224 = ₹600.

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹600.

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Total amount Nitin has = ₹1224

\n

Rate of interest (R) = 4% compounded annually

\n

Time for Pravin (n1) = 14 years

\n

Time for Rishi (n2) = 15 years

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n

Amount in Compound Interest, A = P(1 + R/100)n

\n

Calculation:

\n

⇒ Let Pravin's share be P and Rishi's share be R.

\n

⇒ Amount received by Pravin = P × (1 + 4/100)14

\n

⇒ Amount received by Rishi = R × (1 + 4/100)15

\n

⇒ Since both amounts are equal:

\n

⇒ P × (1 + 4/100)14 = R × (1 + 4/100)15

\n

⇒ P = R × (1 + 4/100)1

\n

⇒ P = R × (1 + 1/25)

\n

⇒ P/R = 26/25

\n

⇒ Total ratio units = 26 + 25 = 51 units

\n

⇒ 51 units = ₹1224

\n

⇒ 1 unit = 1224 ÷ 51 = 24

\n

⇒ Rishi's share (R) = 25 units = 25 × 24 = 600

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹600.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Ratio of Principals for Equal Amounts

\n

When a sum is divided into two parts invested at the same compound interest rate for different time periods such that their amounts are equal, the ratio of the principal amounts is inversely proportional to their respective multiplying factors raised to their time periods.

\n

Compound Interest Multiplying Factor

\n

The multiplying factor for compound interest is (1 + R/100). The amount after n years is the principal multiplied by this factor raised to the power n.

\n

Rule of 72

\n

A quick mental math shortcut to estimate the number of years required to double your money at a given annual rate of return: Years ≈ 72 ÷ Rate.

गणना:

\n\n

माना, प्रवीण की राशि = ₹P और ऋषि की राशि = ₹R.

\n\n

P + R = ₹1224

\n\n

14 वर्षों के बाद प्रवीण की अंतिम राशि = 15 वर्षों के बाद ऋषि की अंतिम राशि।

\n\n

⇒ P × (1 + 4/100)14 = R × (1 + 4/100)15

\n\n

(1 + 4/100) = 1.04

\n\n

⇒ P × (1.04)14 = R × (1.04)15

\n\n

⇒ P × (1.04)14 / (1.04)15 = R

\n\n

⇒ P / 1.04 = R

\n\n

P + R = ₹1224 से:

\n\n

⇒ P + P/1.04 = ₹1224

\n\n

⇒ P(1 + 1/1.04) = ₹1224

\n\n

⇒ P × (1.04 + 1) / 1.04 = ₹1224

\n\n

⇒ P × 2.04 / 1.04 = ₹1224

\n\n

⇒ P = ₹1224 × 1.04 / 2.04

\n\n

⇒ P = ₹624

\n\n

⇒ R = ₹1224 - ₹624

\n\n

⇒ R = ₹600

\n\n

नितिन ने ऋषि को ₹600 दिये थे।

ఇచ్చినవి:

\n\n

నితిన్ వద్ద ₹1224 ఉన్నాయి మరియు అతను తన కుమారులు ప్రవీణ్ మరియు రిషిలకు పంచాడు. ఇద్దరూ తమ తమ వాటాలను వార్షికంగా 4% చక్రవడ్డీతో పెట్టుబడి పెట్టారు.

\n\n

பிரவீனின் தொகை 14 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகும், ரிஷியின் தொகை 15 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகும் சமமாக ஆனது.

பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட சூத்திரம்:

கூட்டு வட்டி சூத்திரம்: இறுதித் தொகை = அசல் x (1 + விகிதம்/100)காலம்

\n\n

\n\n

பிரவீனின் தொகை = ₹P மற்றும் ரிஷியின் தொகை = ₹R என்க.

\n\n

P + R = ₹1224

\n\n

{"prompt": "4", "value": "46"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Total sum of Kiran, Mahesh and Ram = 46 × 3 = 138 kg

\n

Total sum of Kiran and Mahesh = 40 × 2 = 80 kg

\n

Total sum of Mahesh and Ram = 47 × 2 = 94 kg

\n

Weight of Mahesh = (Sum of first two) + (Sum of last two) − (Total Sum)

\n

⇒ 80 + 94 − 138 = 174 − 138 = 36 kg

\n

∴ The correct answer is 36 kg.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Average weight of Kiran, Mahesh and Ram = 46 kg

\n

Average weight of Kiran and Mahesh = 40 kg

\n

Average weight of Mahesh and Ram = 47 kg

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Total Value = Average × Number of Persons

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

Let the weights of Kiran, Mahesh, and Ram be K, M, and R respectively.

\n

⇒ Total weight of all three (K + M + R) = 46 × 3 = 138 kg

\n

⇒ Total weight of Kiran and Mahesh (K + M) = 40 × 2 = 80 kg

\n

⇒ Total weight of Mahesh and Ram (M + R) = 47 × 2 = 94 kg

\n

Adding the sums of the two pairs:

\n

⇒ (K + M) + (M + R) = 80 + 94

\n

⇒ K + 2M + R = 174 kg

\n

To find the weight of Mahesh (M), we subtract the total weight from this overlapping sum:

\n

⇒ M = (K + 2M + R) − (K + M + R)

\n

⇒ M = 174 − 138

\n

⇒ M = 36 kg

\n

∴ The correct answer is 36 kg.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Overlapping Averages

\n

When averages of intersecting sub-groups are given, the common overlapping entity can easily be found by adding the totals of the sub-groups and subtracting the grand total of the entire group.

\n

Inclusion of a New Member

\n

If a new member joins a group and the overall average increases, the new member's value is greater than the previous average. The trick formula is: New Value = Old Average + (Change in Average × New Total Members).

\n

Replacement Method

\n

When an existing member is replaced by a new one, the difference in their values directly impacts the total sum. The shortcut formula is: Value of New Member = Value of Old Member + (Change in Average × Total Members).

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

ಕಿರಣ್, ಮಹೇಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಮ್ ಅವರ ಸರಾಸರಿ ತೂಕ = 46 ಕೆ.ಜಿ.

\n\n

ಕಿರಣ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹೇಶ್ ಅವರ ಸರಾಸರಿ ತೂಕ = 40 ಕೆ.\nಜಿ.

\n\n

ಮಹೇಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಮ್ ಅವರ ಸರಾಸರಿ ತೂಕ = 47 ಕೆ.ಜಿ.

\n\n

ಬಳಸಲಾದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

\n\n

1. ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ / ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ

\n\n

2. ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = ಸರಾಸರಿ x ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

ಕಿರಣ್, ಮಹೇಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಮ್ ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = 46 x 3

\n\n

⇒ ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = 138 ಕೆ.ಜಿ

\n\n

ಕಿರಣ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹೇಶ್ ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = 40 x 2

\n\n

⇒ ಕಿರಣ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹೇಶ್ ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = 80 ಕೆ.ಜಿ

\n\n

ಮಹೇಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಮ್ ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ತೂಕ = 47 x 2આપેલ:

\n\n

કિરણ, મહેશ અને રામનું સરેરાશ વજન = 46 કિગ્રા.

\n\n

કિરણ અને મહેશનું સરેરાશ વજન = 40 કિગ્રા.

\n\n

મહેશ અને રામનું સરેરાશ વજન = 47 કિગ્રા.

\n\n

ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

\n\n

1. સરેરાશ = જથ્થાઓનો સરવાળો / જથ્થાની સંખ્યા

\n\n

2. કુલ વજન = સરેરાશ x વ્યક્તિઓની સંખ્યા

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

કિરણ, મહેશ અને રામનું કુલ વજન = 46 x 3

\n\n

⇒ કુલ વજન = 138 કિગ્રા

\n\n

કિરણ અને મહેશનું કુલ વજન = 40 x 2

\n\n

⇒ કિરણ અને મહેશનું કુલ વજન = 80 કિગ્રા

\n\n

મહેશ અને રામનું કુલ વજન = 47 x 2

\n\n

⇒ મહેશ અને રામનું કુલ વજન = 94 કિગ્રા

\n\n

મહેશનું વજન = (કિરણ અને મહેશનું કુલ વજન) + (મહેશ અને રામનું કુલ વજન) - (કિરણ, મહેશ અને રામનું કુલ વજન)

\n\n

મહેશનું વજન = 80 + 94 - 138

\n\n

મહેશનું વજન = 36 કિગ્રા

\n\n

મહેશનું વજન 36 કિગ્રા છે.

"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Average speed is the weighted average of individual speeds using time as the weight.

\n

Average Speed = (S1 × T1 + S2 × T2) ÷ (T1 + T2)

\n

⇒ Average Speed = (15 × 2 + 20 × 3) ÷ (2 + 3)

\n

⇒ Average Speed = (30 + 60) ÷ 5 = 90 ÷ 5 = 18

\n

∴ The correct answer is 18 km/hr.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Speed 1 (s1) = 15 km/hr, Time 1 (t1) = 2 hours

\n

Speed 2 (s2) = 20 km/hr, Time 2 (t2) = 3 hours

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Distance = Speed × Time

\n

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Distance covered in first part = 15 × 2 = 30 km

\n

⇒ Distance covered in second part = 20 × 3 = 60 km

\n

⇒ Total Distance = 30 + 60 = 90 km

\n

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 3 = 5 hours

\n

⇒ Average Speed = 90 ÷ 5 = 18 km/hr

\n

∴ The correct answer is 18 km/hr.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Average Speed (General Formula)

\n

It is the ratio of total distance travelled to the total time taken for the entire journey. Formula: Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

\n

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

\n

When a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is directly given by the formula 2xy ÷ (x + y).

\n

Relative Speed

\n

When two bodies are moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = |x − y|. When they are moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = x + y.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    • The sentence in Option 2 uses the word \"figurative,\" which is an adjective. However, the sentence requires an adverb to modify the verb \"evaluated.\"

    • An adverb is used to describe how the action of the verb is performed. For example, \"appropriately,\" \"angrily,\" and \"justly\" are correct adverbs that describe the way the teacher evaluated the scripts in the other options.

    • In contrast, \"figurative\" is not an adverb; the correct adverbial form would be \"figuratively,\" but even then, it would not make logical sense in this context.

    • Adjectives: Words that describe nouns or pronouns. They do not modify verbs (e.g., \"beautiful,\" \"large\").
      • \n
    • In this case, \"figurative\" is an adjective and cannot be used to describe the verb \"evaluated.\"

      The correct answer is 'inclement'.

      Complete Sentence: Despite the inclement weather, the festival was a huge success.

Artists like Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo left an incredible mark, (4)________ art (5)______ centuries.

        \n\t
      • Option 1: "had aimed" - This is the past perfect tense, which is used for an action completed before another past action. While grammatically possible in some contexts, "aimed" (simple past) fits better for a continuous characteristic of the period rather than an action completed before another specific past event.
        • \n\t
      • Option 2: "were aiming" - This is the past continuous tense, which suggests an action ongoing at a specific point in the past. While their aiming was continuous, the simple past "aimed" more concisely conveys their general objective during the Renaissance.
        • \n\t
      • Option 4: "was aiming" - This is also past continuous, but "was aiming" is singular, while the subject "They" (referring to artists) is plural. Therefore, it is grammatically incorrect.

        • \n\t
      • Around: "Shift around" would mean moving to different positions, not a directional change from one theme to another.

      Complete Passage: During the Renaissance, artists focused (1) on depicting the beauty of the human form and nature. This period saw a shift (3) from religious themes to a celebration of individualism and classical knowledge. Artists like Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo left an incredible mark, (4.) influencing art (5) ______ centuries.
      \n\n
       
      \n\n
      Additional Information
      \n\n
        \n\t
      • Motivate: To motivate means to provide a reason for doing something. Artists motivate *people* to create, but they don't "motivate art" itself in this context.
        • \n\t
      • Instill: To instill means to establish (an idea or attitude) in someone's mind gradually. While they might instill values *through* art, they don't "instill art" as a concept or practice in this phrase.
        • \n\t
      • Encourage: To encourage means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. While they encouraged *other artists*, they didn't "encourage art" as a direct object in this way; "influencing" is a more fitting description of their legacy on the art form itself.

                              'प्रत्यक्ष' शब्द में संधि है - 'यण'

                              \n\n
                                \n\t
                              • 'प्रत्यक्ष' शब्द का संधि विच्छेद - प्रति + अक्ष = प्रत्यक्ष (इ + अ = य)\n\n\t
                                  \n\t\t
                                • प्रत्यक्ष - स्पष्ट दिखाई पड़नेवाला।
                                  • \n\t
                                \n\t
                                • \n\t
                              • जब संधि करते समय (इ, ई) के साथ कोई अन्य स्वर हो तो ‘य‘ बन जाता है,
                                • \n\t
                              • जब (उ, ऊ) के साथ कोई अन्य स्वर हो तो ‘व‘ बन जाता है ,
                                • \n\t
                              • जब (ऋ) के साथ कोई अन्य स्वर हो तो ‘र‘ बन जाता है।
                                • \n
                              \n\n

                              उदाहरण-

                              \n\n
                                \n\t
                              • अति + अंत = अत्यंत (इ + अ = य)
                                • \n\t
                              • अनु + आय = अन्वय (उ + अ= व)
                                • \n\t
                              • पितृ + आदेश = पित्रादेश (ऋ + आ= रा)
                                • \n
